Cowboy Cheeseburgers
By: Andie Mitchell
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 8:56pm

Ingredients




1 pound Extra-lean ground beef
1 small Onion, chopped fine
1 tablespoon Fresh jalapeno chile, minced
1 teaspoon Ground coriander
1 teaspoon Ground cumin
1 teaspoon Salt
1 teaspoon Pepper, fresh ground
1 cup mozzarella cheese, grated
4 Tortillas
4 Tomato slices
Cliantro sprigs
1/4 cup Commerical taco sauce

Preparation

1 In a large bowl, mix the ground beef, onion, jalapeno, coriander, cumin, salt, and pepper; form into burgers of equal size about 1/4 inch thick without compacting the meat. Grill or broil, 4" from source of heat, for 3 minutes on each side for medium-rare patties. Place the mozzarella cheese on the top center of each patty. Cook for another minute and until cheese melts. Serve each patty on a warmed 8" flour tortilla, topped with a tomato slice, cilantro sprigs, and taco sauce.
